# coreweave_arca_advanced_mode (Resource)

Enables and manages Arca Advanced Mode for the organization authenticated by the provider token. Advanced Mode reconciles applications declared in `.arca/apps.yaml` from a connected GitHub repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coreweave_arca_advanced_mode" "platform" {
  github_installation_id = var.github_installation_id
  repository             = "https://github.com/acme/platform-config"
  branch                 = "main"
  manifest_path          = ".arca/apps.yaml"

  # Keep false unless destroying this resource should also remove applications
  # currently managed through .arca/apps.yaml.
  allow_destroy_apps = false

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `github_installation_id` (String) The GitHub App installation ID already connected to the authenticated CoreWeave organization.
- `repository` (String) The GitHub repository containing the Arca application manifest.

### Optional

- `allow_destroy_apps` (Boolean) When true, Terraform may disable Advanced Mode even when Arca-managed applications still exist. This sends `force=true` during deletion.
- `branch` (String) The Git branch containing the application manifest. Defaults to `main`.
- `manifest_path` (String) The repository-relative Arca application manifest path. Currently fixed to `.arca/apps.yaml`.

### Read-Only

- `app_count` (Number) The number of applications currently managed through Advanced Mode.
- `available_repositories` (Attributes List) Repositories accessible through the selected GitHub App installation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--available_repositories))
- `conditions` (Attributes List) Detailed reconciliation conditions reported by Arca. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether Arca can authenticate through the GitHub App installation.
- `id` (String) The server-generated Advanced Mode identifier.
- `last_error` (String) The most recent Advanced Mode reconciliation error.
- `last_reconciled_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last successful reconciliation.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the current Advanced Mode configuration has reconciled successfully.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coreweave_arca_advanced_mode.platform cw1234-github
```
